decisions.reason: The Black Edition range is publicly announced as part of the firm's design-led bathroom concept and was moved to a page of its own in 2024, so the visible commitment and the investment in several models favour keeping it.

CeraFrame Liquid fits the firm's announced direction toward seamless, barrier-free bathrooms and has had a page of its own in both years, so it is central to the strategy and its results are likely to be read as still developing.
The pump-drain shower channel was launched only in 2024 as a further development of the pump-assisted line, so management would treat any weak early results as temporary and keep investing in it.
